note: Read 2026-10-31. The NPC's own sites (npc.gov.cn gave no answer; flk.npc.gov.cn is a script-only app) weren't read; the laws were read in the texts published by 12371.cn (the Communist Party's official members' site, carrying Xinhua's texts) and the Shanghai Development and Reform Commission's PDFs. Majority: 民法典 (Civil Code, adopted 28 May 2020, in force 1 January 2021), art. 17: a natural person of eighteen or more is an adult; art. 18: an adult has full civil capacity; a minor of sixteen or more living mainly on his or her own labour income is deemed to have full capacity (not held). Work: 劳动法 (Labour Law, 1994, as amended 2009 and 2018), art. 15: employers may not recruit minors under sixteen; arts, sports and special-craft units recruiting under-sixteens must follow the State's rules and protect their compulsory schooling. Before the 2018 amendment art. 15 also required an approval procedure (履行审批手续); the current text, read here, has none. 禁止使用童工规定 (State Council Decree No. 364, in force 1 December 2002), art. 2: no unit may employ anyone under sixteen; art. 13: arts and sports units may, with the parents' or guardian's consent, recruit professional performers and athletes under sixteen, and must protect their health and schooling; the detailed measures are left to the labour ministry with culture and sport (not found). Held 'free': the law sets no permit or lowest age, only the parents' consent, which the form doesn't hold. Service: 兵役法 (Military Service Law, revised 20 August 2021, in force 1 October 2021), art. 15: every male citizen turning eighteen by 31 December registers that year; art. 20: men of eighteen are to be conscribed into active service, and if not called that year may be until twenty-two (university graduates to twenty-four, postgraduates to twenty-six, not held); women may be conscribed as the army needs (not held, as the law calls only men as of right); volunteers of seventeen may be taken; art. 26: conscripts serve two years. The service system is 'mainly volunteer' (art. 3); the form holds the law's call.

sources.title: 中华人民共和国民法典 (12371.cn, 共产党员网)
sources.said: 第十七条　十八周岁以上的自然人为成年人。不满十八周岁的自然人为未成年人。 ... 第十八条　成年人为完全民事行为能力人，可以独立实施民事法律行为。

sources.title: 中华人民共和国劳动法 (12371.cn, 共产党员网)
sources.said: 第十五条　禁止用人单位招用未满十六周岁的未成年人。 ... 文艺、体育和特种工艺单位招用未满十六周岁的未成年人，必须遵守国家有关规定，并保障其接受义务教育的权利。

sources.title: 中华人民共和国兵役法 (2021年8月20日修订) (12371.cn, 新华社)
sources.said: 第十五条　每年十二月三十一日以前年满十八周岁的男性公民，都应当按照兵役机关的安排在当年进行初次兵役登记。 ... 第二十条　年满十八周岁的男性公民，应当被征集服现役；当年未被征集的，在二十二周岁以前仍可以被征集服现役。 ... 根据军队需要，可以按照前款规定征集女性公民服现役。 ... 第二十六条　义务兵服现役的期限为二年。
